question:
Directions: Each of the following sentences in this section has a blank space with four options. Select whichever preposition or determiner you consider the most appropriate for the blank space and indicate your response on the Answer Sheet accordingly.

They never made much money, in spite _______ their success.
solution:
The correct answer is ‘of’.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The above sentence is an example of a preposition.
 
• A preposition is a word used to link nouns, pronouns, or phrases to other words within a sentence.
 
• As per the general rule, 'in spite of' is a prepositional phrase which means "**link two contrasting ideas or show that one fact makes the other fact surprising**".
 
• It can be be used at the beginning or in the middle of the sentence. 
 
• Example:​
 
 
• *They went out **in spite of** the rain. (correct)*
 
• *They went out **in spite for/on** the rain. (incorrect)*
 
 
 
• *​*According to the explanation and example that are given above, ‘of’ is the correct choice for the given blank.

Correct sentence: *They never made much money, **in spite of** their success.*
